pitfalls: Which file: block 32 (model.litertlm) is the quality pick — GSM8K 88.0% vs 81.0% for block 128 — while block 128 (model_block128.litertlm) decodes ~40% faster on the iPhone 17 Pro (14 vs 10 tok/s; Mac M-series GPU 66-68 vs 64-73 tok/s) (HF card 'Which file?').
Blockwise (not the tool's default channelwise) int4 is what preserves accuracy; embeddings kept at INT8 and externalized into their own section (dedups the tied matrix) (HF card Conversion).
